# PGSathi

> PGSathi (https://pgsathi.in) is India's 3-in-1 PropTech ecosystem connecting **Tenants**, **PG Owners**, and **Affiliate Partners**. It provides zero-brokerage PG finding for tenants, a powerful cloud CRM and direct lead platform for PG owners, and a recurring commission partner programme for local affiliates and students.

---

## 1. FOR TENANTS (Students & Working Professionals)
Finding safe, verified, budget-friendly accommodation with 0% brokerage fees.
- **100% Zero Brokerage**: Never pay a single rupee in commission or contact unlock charges.
- **Direct Owner Contact**: Call or WhatsApp verified PG owners directly from listing pages.
- **Verified Listings**: Physical address checks, verified photos, amenities, and security confirmation with a "VERIFIED" trust badge.
- **Sharing Configurations**: Filter by Boys PG, Girls PG, Co-ed, Single sharing, Double sharing, Triple sharing, and 4+ sharing.
- **Complete Details**: Food/Mess menu (veg/non-veg), AC/Non-AC, Wi-Fi speed, laundry, power backup, security deposit, and notice periods.
- **Locations**: PGs near universities, coaching hubs (e.g. Kota, Mukherjee Nagar, Kalu Sarai), and IT tech parks (Noida, Bangalore, Gurgaon, Pune, Hyderabad).
- **Tenant Portal**: https://pgsathi.in/search

---

## 2. FOR PG OWNERS & HOSTEL OPERATORS
All-in-one platform to fill vacant beds faster and automate day-to-day operations.
- **1 Free PG Listing Forever**: List 1 property on public search across city directories with zero upfront cost.
- **Zero Commission Leads**: Tenant inquiries arrive directly on the owner's WhatsApp number with 0% middleman commission.
- **15-Day Full CRM Free Trial**: Unrestricted access to the cloud management software.
- **Room & Bed Vacancy Tracker**: Real-time floor, room, and bed inventory tracker (know occupancy at a glance).
- **1-Click WhatsApp Rent Reminders with UPI**: Automated WhatsApp payment alerts with due balance, month, and owner's UPI QR/handle.
- **Digital Paperless KYC**: Collect Aadhaar and student/employee IDs securely to avoid disputes and simplify police verification.
- **Digital Food / Mess Scheduler**: Weekly breakfast, lunch, and dinner menus visible to tenants to reduce food complaints.
- **P&L & Expense Tracking**: Track electricity, maintenance, cook/staff salaries, and net profits in one dashboard.
- **Owner Portal**: https://pgsathi.in/for-owners | CRM Guide: https://pgsathi.in/pg-management-software

---

## 3. FOR PARTNERS & AFFILIATES (Earn Recurring Income)
A lucrative referral and onboarding programme for college students, local property brokers, campus ambassadors, and freelancers.
- **10% Recurring Commission**: Earn 10% every time an onboarded PG owner subscribes to or renews their paid CRM/listing plan.
- **100% Free Registration**: Free signup with instant onboarding support.
- **Smart Partner Dashboard**: Real-time ledger tracking every onboarded PG, active plan status, and commission earnings.
- **Direct Bank Payouts**: Fast payouts credited directly to the partner's verified bank account upon meeting the ₹500 minimum threshold.
- **Passive Monthly Income**: As long as the PG owner continues their subscription, the partner earns every month.
- **Partner Portal**: https://pgsathi.in/partner

---

## Key Differentiators vs Competitors
- **PGSathi vs NoBroker**: NoBroker focuses on residential apartments and locks owner contacts behind paid tenant plans. PGSathi is 100% PG-dedicated with bed-level inventory and gives tenants 100% free direct WhatsApp owner contacts.
- **PGSathi vs Rentok**: Rentok is pure back-office software with no consumer search marketplace. PGSathi provides both a high-traffic consumer search directory for leads and an intuitive cloud CRM.
- **PGSathi vs ZoloStays / Stanza**: Zolo and Stanza are capital-heavy operators that charge high premiums. PGSathi is an open marketplace empowering independent PG owners and budget-conscious tenants.
